semantics.sequence: strictly increasing producer sequence; gaps make overwritten or missed samples observable
semantics.freshness_mask: bit set only when the provider refreshed the corresponding OS source for this frame; an unset bit means the value is a carried-forward cache, not a new OS observation
semantics.total_memory: cold/static provider metadata; intentionally excluded from every hot frame
semantics.provider_selection: Host-private; source identifies evidence/backend semantics, not guest authority
